pr_title: roachtest: fix single node sysbench setup
pr_body:
The single node setup was accidentally using HAProxy for the prepare step, causing it to silently fail and segfault later on. Since segfaults are an ignored error, the single node tests were silently failing.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/139024
Epic: none
Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/139042)

Kicked off some sysbench runs here: https://teamcity.cockroachdb.com/buildConfiguration/Cockroach_Nightlies_RoachtestNightlyGceBazel/18497011?hideProblemsFromDependencies=false&hideTestsFromDependencies=false

Ah, looks like this is a [brand new regression from yesterday](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/commit/9a261a669ca969557531061467539b202ffb08df). 😅 Phew, thought that it had been silently failing ever since we turned on secure clusters.

TFTR!

bors r=srosenberg

comments:
`sysbench` setup is unable to connect to the cluster and setup:

```
run_135102.614322747_n2_sysbench-dbdriverpgs: 2025/01/14 13:51:02 cluster.go:2501: > sysbench \
		--db-driver=pgsql \
		--pgsql-host=127.0.0.1 \
		--pgsql-port=26257 \
		--pgsql-user=roachprod \
		--pgsql-password=cockroachdb \
		--pgsql-db=sysbench \
		--report-interval=1 \
		--rand-type=uniform \
		--time=600 \
		--threads=64 \
		--tables=10 \
		--table_size=10000000 \
		--auto_inc=false \
		oltp_insert prepare
sysbench 1.0.20 (using system LuaJIT 2.1.0-beta3)

Initializing worker threads...
FATAL: Connection to database failed: connection to server at "127.0.0.1", port 26257 failed: Connection refused
	Is the server running on that host and accepting TCP/IP connections?
```

The prepare command doesn't return exit 1 so `c.Run` doesn't realize it failed and attempts to run sysbench. That seems to connect fine but fails when it can't find any of the tables.

Possibly just a network blip, but I'm not seeing anything weird pop up in the logs suggesting so. The rest of the sysbench tests, some running concurrently with this one, seem to have passed just fine

Hmm, perhaps I spoke too soon, `sysbench/oltp_delete/nodes=1/cpu=32/conc=64` is failing too, but silently as it seg faults which is a failure we ignore. The 3 node tests are working fine though - which gives me a good guess of whats wrong.

review_comments: Think this should be okay to do, looks like sysbench [doesn't do any retry logic](https://github.com/akopytov/sysbench/blob/de18a036cc65196b1a4966d305f33db3d8fa6f8e/src/lua/oltp_common.lua#L90-L93) so if we get just one FATAL we know setup for sure failed.
